methodologyNotes: Ten percussive therapy devices were re-verified spanning the $65–$600 range: flagship pro models (Theragun PRO, Hypervolt 2 Pro), mid-range (Theragun Elite, Ekrin B37, Hypervolt 2), budget guns (Bob and Brad C2, Renpho Active, Sportneer Elite D9), the specialty TimTam PowerMassager Pro, and the compact Theragun Mini. Sources: manufacturer pages (therabody.com, hyperice.com, ekrin.com [ekrinathletics.com now 301-redirects to ekrin.com], timtamperformance.com, renpho.com), major retailers (Amazon, Best Buy), and independent test-lab reviews (Massage Gun Advice, Treadmill Review Guru, The Gadgeteer, connectthewatts.com). Hyperice does NOT publish stall force or amplitude officially (confirmed via massagegunadvice.com testing notes) — those values are reviewer-measured and stall_force is null for both Hypervolt models. Amplitude/stall values are manufacturer-stated unless noted reviewer-estimated. battery_hours reflects manufacturer claim at light use unless a tested figure was reported. Prices reflect the current published US price at the named manufacturer page or major retailer as of 2026-06-15; original launch MSRPs are noted in priceNote/provenance where they differ. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Theragun PRO (5th Generation)
products.priceNote: Current therabody.com listing $529.99; launch MSRP was $599. Frequently discounted to ~$349-399 at retail.
products.provenance: Current price corrected from $599 to $529.99 per the live therabody.com PRO product page (fetched 2026-06-15); launch MSRP was $599 (connectthewatts.com review). Amplitude 16mm, stall force 60 lbs, 5 speeds (1750-2400 PPM), 6 attachments, 2.9 lb weight, and ~150 min (2.5h) battery confirmed via connectthewatts.com launch review and Best Buy listing. Note: the live therabody page currently advertises 2.2 lb / 120 min, which conflicts with the well-documented original 5th-gen figures (2.9 lb / 150 min); the durable, multiply-corroborated 5th-gen specs are retained.

products.priceNote: MSRP at launch September 14, 2023; current therabody.com list price

products.name: Theragun Mini (2nd Generation)
products.priceNote: Launch MSRP and current list price
products.provenance: $199 MSRP confirmed (Therabody listings, Portland Running, Rogue Fitness). Stall force ~20 lbs is a reviewer estimate; Therabody publishes no official figure.

Five speeds (1700/1900/2100/2400/2700 PPM), 3h battery, 2.6 lb, 5 attachments confirmed.

products.name: TimTam PowerMassager Pro
products.priceNote: Current timtamperformance.com price for v3.0 ($199.99, sale from $249.99).
products.provenance: 20mm stroke length confirmed on the timtamperformance.com v3.0 page and product blog (earlier v2 was marketed at 32mm). Three deep-tissue speeds (1000/2000/2800 strokes/min); max PPM noted as 2800 on the spec listing (TimTam's own materials also state 'up to 2500' — figure is internally inconsistent, 2800 retained as top speed setting). 1h battery and 2.0 lb confirmed on activerecoveryessentials.com. attachments_count set to null: contested across pages (3 tips on the 'with heat' listing vs 8 attachments on the v3.0 page) with no consistent figure. stall_force null: no official figure published. Price $199.99 per timtamperformance.com v3.0 page (note activerecoveryessentials lists a $499.99 'with heat' variant — distinct config).
